items.title: Mr. X Interview, 1961-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is a receipt that was used in Thompson, in Hortman's book... That was your name.

ctx.x: I'm wondering if there's anything about these cards.
This is a receipt that was used in Thompson, in Hortman's book, on the bibliography of the book, you know. Oh, yes. But I don't know what you want. That was your name.
Yes, we'll take a picture of it anyway, as long as we have a lot of film.
